svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Angular Developer roadmap
svg.desc: 01 HTML, CSS and Accessibility: Semantic HTML, CSS layout, Responsive design, Accessibility basics, Styling approaches; 02 JavaScript and TypeScript: Modern JavaScript, Asynchronous JavaScript, TypeScript essentials, Packages and build tools, Linting and formatting; 03 Framework Fundamentals: Components and templates, Inputs and outputs, Signals, Control flow, Handling events, Angular DevTools; 04 State and Data Flow: Computed signals, Effects and when to avoid them, Services and dependency injection, RxJS and signals, View queries, Shared state libraries; 05 Routing: Client-side routing, URL parameters and query strings, Layouts and nested routes, Route guards, Lazy-loaded routes; 06 Forms and Validation: Signal Forms, Schema validation with Zod, Reactive forms, Accessible error messages; 07 Working with APIs: The HTTP client and interceptors, Resources and httpResource, Handling API errors, Rendering user content safely, Tokens in the browser, CORS; 08 Rendering and the Meta-Framework: Server-side rendering, Hydration, Data on the server, Render modes, Authentication on the server, Analog; 09 Testing: Component tests, Testing HTTP calls, End-to-end tests with Playwright, Accessibility testing; 10 Performance and Production: Core Web Vitals, Bundle size and code splitting, Images and fonts, Security headers, Error monitoring and logging, Deployment
svg.text: Effects and when to avoid them
Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
